text: But we must let the mounds dry overnight in the center of the field before we divide them.
The night air sweetens the oils.'
That night, unable to contain his greed, Bouki crept into the darkened field under the crescent moon to feast upon the mounds before Leuk could return.
But Leuk had prepared for his partner's hunger.
He had placed a large hollow clay pot coated with sticky sap right at the center of the largest mound, draping it with fresh vines.
